info.name: Pack Referrals API
info.description:
Every endpoint on main, each with a saved example from a real local run.

**Run it all:** `postman/run_collection.sh` (throwaway database and server; see postman/README.md). **In the Postman app:** run `python manage.py seed_demo_data` locally, paste each printed value into the collection variable of the same name (`sender_token`, `recipient_id`, `verify_code`, ...), then run the folders top to bottom: later folders use ids the earlier ones save.

Requests act as the sender unless their Authorization tab says otherwise. Never point this at staging: it creates and deletes data, and the seed is local only.

item.name: Health and docs
item.description: Public. Monitoring and the API reference; no token needed.

response.name: 200 OK
response.body:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Pack Referrals API
  version: 0.1.0
  description: 'Verified NC State referral network. Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.'
paths:
  /api/accounts/alumni-access-requests/:
    post:
      operationId: accounts_alumni_access_requests_create
      description: |-
        Public: submit a request to be let in as an alum.

        Write-only and deliberately dull. It answers the same way whether the
        request was stored, was a duplicate, or tripped the honeypot, so it cannot
        be used to find out who has already applied.
      tags:
      - accounts
      security:
      - jwtAuth: []
      - cookieAuth: []
      - {}
      responses:
        '200':
          description: No response body
  /api/accounts/auth/login/:
    post:
      operationId: accounts_auth_login_create
      description: Send a returning user a fresh code. There is no password to check.
      tags:
      - accounts
      security:
      - jwtAuth: []
      - cookieAuth: []
      - {}
      responses:
        '200':
          description: No response body
  /api/accounts/auth/refresh/:
    post:
      operationId: accounts_auth_refresh_create
      description: |-
        Takes a refresh type JSON web token and returns an access type JSON web
        token if the refresh token is valid.
      tags:
      - accounts
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/TokenRefresh'
          appl

... (cut by save_examples.py; 40855 characters in full)

item.name: Outsider sends the recipient a request
Referrals
item.description: Asks for a referral between accepted connections. Needs the Connections folder first. Write fields: `recipient_id`, `role_title` (max 255), `contact_email` (required, where the recipient can reach the sender), `message_text` (max 500), and optional `company_id` (must be on the recipient's profile), `job_url`, `resume_url` (http/https). A folder-level test checks every referral in a response against `REFERRAL_FIELDS`; extend that list when adding a field. Not on main yet: `PATCH /api/connections/referrals/<id>/accept|decline/`.
